title: Dot product of a lifted coordinate frequency
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices, and let $\gamma$ be a binary vector indexed by the elements of $J$ in their induced order. For every binary vector $x$ of length $n$, the dot product of the coordinate frequency lift of $\gamma$ with $x$ equals the dot product of $\gamma$ with the restriction of $x$ to $J$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $J$ of coordinate indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
A binary vector indexed by the ordered elements of $J$
